goal_a_reason: Free-text chatbot replies require semantic similarity scoring that tolerates paraphrasing, which only an LLM judge can assess; no tool-call inspection is needed, so the basic output variant suffices.
goal_b_reason: Structured JSON with a known expected object should be compared deterministically using tree-based similarity that tolerates key ordering and minor whitespace differences without invoking an LLM.
goal_c_reason: A pass/fail check for the literal substring 'deployment succeeded' is exactly what the contains evaluator provides — binary, deterministic, no LLM needed.
